item.title: CBS News Postpones '60 Minutes' Segment Featuring CECOT
item.description: Correspondent Sharyn Alfonsi described the decision by the editor-in-chief to postpone her segment as "political," arguing it was factually correct and ready to air.

item.title: Exclusive Photos: JD Vance joins Navy SEAL training, pushes limits in grueling
item.description: Vice President JD Vance trains with Navy SEALs in grueling 90-minute workout, carrying logs and climbing obstacles. The Marine veteran says troops went easy on him.

item.title: State Department Recalls 29 Ambassadors

item.title: Pentagon taps Musk's xAI to boost sensitive government workflows, support
item.description: Pentagon partners with Elon Musk's xAI to deploy Grok AI across military systems, giving 3 million personnel advanced AI tools by 2026 for sensitive tasks.

item.title: Trump announces plans for new Navy 'battleship' as part of a 'Golden Fleet'

item.title: 20% of NYC mayor-elect Mamdani transition appointees have anti-Zionist ties: ADL

item.title: Nicki Minaj Surprises With Appearance at Americafest: Panelists Debate
